title: The Name of the Lord is a Strong Tower

questions.question: The name of the Lord is a strong what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:10 (ESV): "The name of the Lord is a strong tower;"

questions.question: The righteous runs into it and is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:10 (ESV): "the righteous man runs into it and is safe."

questions.question: Before destruction a man's heart is haughty, but humility comes before what?
Death and life are in the power of the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:21 (ESV): "Death and life are in the power of the tongue,"

questions.question: He who finds a wife finds a good thing and obtains favor from whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:22 (ESV): "and obtains favor from the Lord."

questions.question: Whoever isolates himself seeks his own desire; he breaks out against all sound what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:1 (ESV): "he breaks out against all sound judgment."

questions.question: A fool takes no pleasure in understanding, but only in expressing his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:2 (ESV): "but only in expressing his opinion."

questions.question: The words of a whisperer are like delicious morsels; they go down into the inner parts of the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:8 (ESV): "they go down into the inner parts of the body."

questions.question: A wealthy man's wealth is his strong city, and like a high wall in his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:11 (ESV): "and like a high wall in his imagination."

questions.question: The one who states his case first seems right, until the other comes and does what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:17 (ESV): "until the other comes and examines him."

questions.question: The words of a man's mouth are deep waters; the fountain of wisdom is a bubbling what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:4 (ESV): "the fountain of wisdom is a bubbling brook."

questions.question: A fool's lips walk into a fight, and his mouth invites a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:6 (ESV): "and his mouth invites a beating."

questions.question: The lot puts an end to quarrels and decides between what?
A brother offended is more unyielding than a strong what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:19 (ESV): "A brother offended is more unyielding than a strong city,"

questions.question: A man of many companions may come to ruin, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:24 (ESV): "but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother."

key_verse_text: The name of the Lord is a strong tower; the righteous man runs into it and is safe.
